description: Free outline with section ids, headings, byte sizes, and a fingerprint, without page body text or payment. A later clean_extract call can select sections and is charged only when it returns usable content. Uncharged failures name upstream_timeout, upstream_http_error, bot_challenge, js_shell, empty_extraction, or sections_not_found. Recoverable structured data names fallback_used.

url_or_html.description: A public HTTP(S) URL or a raw HTML string to convert into Markdown.
